definitions.explanation: delivery date; deadline (for delivery or completion)

examples.japanese: {納期|のうき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いつ→いつ：00536_itsu⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
{納期|のうき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{間|ま}に{合|あ}わない→間に合う：01142_maniau⟧⟦かもしれない→かもしれない：00164_kamoshirenai⟧。
examples.english: We might not make the deadline.

examples.japanese: ⟦お{客様|きゃくさま}→お客様：08780_okyakusama⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ご⟦{要望|ようぼう}→要望：14111_youbou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{応|おう}じて→応じる：02018_oujiru⟧{納期|のうき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調整|ちょうせい}→調整：14839_chousei⟧⟦いたします→いたす：01314_itasu⟧。
examples.english: We will adjust the delivery date according to the customer's request.

notes:
{納期|のうき} refers to the scheduled date for delivery of goods or completion of work.

Common expressions:
- {納期|のうき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}る→守る：01986_mamoru⟧ (meet the deadline)
- {納期|のうき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{間|ま}に{合|あ}う→間に合う：01142_maniau⟧ (make the deadline)
- {納期|のうき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{延|の}ばす→延ばす：28291_nobasu⟧ (extend the deadline)
- {納期|のうき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{迫|せま}る→迫る：03928_semaru⟧ (the deadline is approaching)

Used primarily in business and manufacturing contexts for delivery schedules or project completion dates.
